name: Dual-Head Circle-Aware Crater Detector
description: Advisory crater and obstacle detection model operating on 256x256 lunar orthoimagery tiles at 0.5-2.0 m/px.
intended_use: Advisory rover traverse constraint and landing site obstacle mapping. Not a flight-qualified autonomous navigation system.

training_manifest.catalog_license: Apache-2.0 (Synthetic fixtures, clearly labeled per AGENTS.md)

limitations: Advisory only; terrain slope hazards must always be evaluated independently.
Reduced recall under high sun illumination (incidence < 60 deg) due to lack of shadow contrast.
Tile-level receptive field limits single-pass detection of craters larger than 100 meters diameter.
Optical blur degrades detection recall significantly.
